assertionResults.title: ORD–LGA controls drive visible scenario-state changes

steps.action: Open the ORD-LGA route on the shared runtime and inspect visible controls near the pricing evidence rail and chapter sections.
steps.expected: Scenario controls or visual modes are present and lead to visible changes in selected-day readout plus at least one chart or KPI.
steps.observed: The visible controls were limited to the pricing evidence rail filters: all, shock, anomaly, inflection, and recommendation. No scenario sliders or selected-day interaction surfaced in the real browser session.

steps.action: Scroll further and wait for the lower interactive sandbox to mount.
steps.expected: Interactive Chapter B mounts with scenario sliders, stress charts, and recommendation console.
steps.observed: The lower section remained on the placeholder copy 'Interactive controls are loading. Scroll a bit further or wait one moment for the full simulator.' with supporting text 'Incoming modules Scenario sliders, stress charts, and recommendation console.'

steps.action: Click the visible recommendation filter in the pricing evidence rail.
steps.expected: At least one visible label, value, chart state, or selected-day readout changes.
steps.observed: No user-visible state change was confirmed in the browser output or text capture after clicking the recommendation filter.

observedCopy: Interactive Chapter B · Counterfactual Command Sandbox
Interactive controls are loading. Scroll a bit further or wait one moment for the full simulator.
Incoming modules Scenario sliders, stress charts, and recommendation console.
evidence.changedLabelsOrValues: No confirmed change after clicking the visible recommendation filter; selected-day readout never became user-interactable.
evidence.network: No requests captured by agent-browser during the interaction sequence.

assertionResults.issues: The real user surface did not expose working scenario controls or a visible selected-day interaction that changed the live outputs.

assertionResults.title: ORD–LGA presents chaptered analysis from market view to validation

steps.action: Inspect the full route from hero through the lower interactive sections.
steps.expected: The route presents distinct analytical chapters spanning market intelligence, strategy/reaction analysis, and model validation.
steps.observed: The route shows top-level trust/provenance and assumptions surfaces, then 'Interactive Chapter A Counterfactual Pricing Simulator' and a placeholder for 'Interactive Chapter B · Counterfactual Command Sandbox'.

steps.action: Look for visible validation-specific or reaction-analysis chapters beyond the first simulator section.
steps.expected: A reviewer can visibly distinguish market view, strategy/reaction analysis, and validation chapters from the rendered page.
steps.observed: A separate validation chapter was not visibly rendered; the only validation-specific visible copy was the inline note 'Validation MAPE: 5.49%' inside the evidence rail area.

observedCopy: Interactive Chapter A Counterfactual Pricing Simulator
Annotation Intent Each callout ties to route-day outcomes and provenance. Validation MAPE: 5.49%
Interactive Chapter B · Counterfactual Command Sandbox
evidence.network: No requests captured by agent-browser during the route inspection.

assertionResults.issues: The rendered route did not visibly deliver the full chapter sequence required by the assertion; validation and deeper strategy/reaction content remained collapsed behind an unloaded placeholder.

assertionResults.title: ORD–LGA recommendation output is evidence-linked and uncertainty-aware

steps.action: Inspect the top summary and trust surfaces for recommendation framing.
steps.expected: Recommendation output is tied to lift/risk metrics and rationale while preserving modeled and uncertainty-aware language.
steps.observed: Top-of-page framing is uncertainty-aware: 'Revenue Lift CI $58K — $96K', 'Modeled incremental Q2 lift $567K', and 'Limitation: Competitor policy is inferred, not observed from internal airline systems.'

steps.action: Scroll to the lower recommendation area expected from the interactive sandbox.
steps.expected: A dedicated recommendation area is visibly rendered with supporting evidence and risk-linked outputs.
steps.observed: The lower section never mounted beyond placeholder text announcing an incoming recommendation console, so a recommendation area tied to visible supporting evidence was not reachable.

observedCopy: Limitation: Competitor policy is inferred, not observed from internal airline systems.
Incoming modules Scenario sliders, stress charts, and recommendation console.
evidence.changedLabelsOrValues: Visible uncertainty framing exists near the top, but no rendered recommendation console or risk-linked interactive output became available.
evidence.network: No requests captured by agent-browser during the recommendation-area check.

assertionResults.issues: The page preserves uncertainty-aware language, but the dedicated recommendation output area required by the assertion was not present in the tested runtime.

assertionResults.title: ORD–LGA loading or failure states remain recoverable

steps.action: Attempt to observe a reproducible route-level loading or failure state on the assigned route without disrupting shared infrastructure.
steps.expected: If a loading or failure state appears, it is ORD-LGA-specific and offers a visible recovery path.
steps.observed: A route-level loading or failure state was not reproducibly triggered. The only consistently visible loading copy was the lower lazy placeholder for interactive controls, not a route-level failure or recovery flow.

observedCopy: Interactive controls are loading. Scroll a bit further or wait one moment for the full simulator.
evidence.recoverabilityVisible: Not determinable for a route-level state because no reproducible route-level loading/failure surface was reached.
evidence.network: No requests captured by agent-browser during the blocked assertion attempt.

assertionResults.issues: Per task guidance, the assertion is blocked because a route-level loading or failure state could not be triggered reproducibly on the shared validation surface.

frictions.description: Visible page text extraction on this Next.js App Router route included streamed payload/script text after the visible content, so screenshots were the primary trustworthy evidence surface.
frictions.resolution: Used multiple screenshots plus direct visible-copy capture from the rendered page instead of relying on raw body text alone.

frictions.description: The lower ORD-LGA interactive sandbox never mounted beyond a loading placeholder despite additional scrolling and waiting on the production-like runtime.
frictions.resolution: None during this rerun; evidence recorded as observed.

blockers.description: A route-level loading or failure state could not be reproduced without modifying shared infrastructure or forcing unsupported fault injection on the mission-managed runtime.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried by scrolling deeper, waiting several additional seconds, and re-checking the rendered lower section, but no route-level recovery state surfaced.

summary: Tested 4 assigned assertions on the real ORD-LGA route: 0 passed, 3 failed, 1 blocked. The page still exposes top-level trust and uncertainty copy, but the deeper interactive sandbox and recommendation console did not mount on the shared 3501 runtime, and a reproducible route-level loading/failure state was not available.
